narrative: Material PL2__M22478CA exhibits a smooth demand pattern (CV=0.47) with a statistically significant positive trend of +1.17 units/day across 237 working days. Lead time averages 3.69 days with moderate variability (CV=0.35), and lead time variance is the dominant buffer driver at 67.2% of total sigma_LTD. A (r,Q) continuous review policy is selected as appropriate for smooth, high-frequency demand: safety stock is set at 1,286 units to meet the 95% service level (vs SAP's under-specified 944 units), with a reorder point of 3,109 and EOQ-derived order quantity of 846 units. The SAP safety lead time of 3.80 days is overstated versus the data-driven recommendation of 2.60 days and should be reduced.
warnings: Optimised policy increases annual holding cost by $12,307.31 (19.12%) vs SAP baseline due to higher safety stock required for 95% service level coverage given actual demand and lead time variability.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Smooth demand with CV=0.47 and non-zero fraction of 98.7% justifies a normal approximation safety stock model. Continuous review is appropriate for a moderate-to-high volume material where stockout cost is significant and demand is near-daily.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Peak post-replenishment inventory of 2,132 units is well below the 6,465-unit storage cap — no capacity constraint binds. If demand trend continues at +1.17 units/day, annual mean demand will grow ~300 units/day within 12 months; safety stock and ROP should be reviewed quarterly.
